title: Error-Recovery Safety Benchmark: Do Agents Fail Safe or Fail Loud?

original_idea.body: # Error-Recovery Safety Benchmark: Do Agents Fail Safe or Fail Loud?

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: most real incidents happen during error handling; fail-safe vs fail-dangerous is high-leverage.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: deterministic mock-tool failures + classify recovery; API agents.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: per-model unsafe-recovery rate across deterministic failure injections.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: mock failures, API agents, fully counterfactual.

novelty.reasoning: Error-detection benchmarks exist; safe-vs-unsafe recovery benchmark may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A fail-safe-vs-fail-dangerous recovery benchmark likely missing.
